argv: could not tell what Skip skips
Settled by the owner's defaults, decision 0242 (replay-ceremony ui 10): Pause and Skip to end
0242: the room is topRow() since replay-ceremony ui 10, and 390 px is now tight too
ops.body: - [loop] From the UI review (Nov 18, low): Next sits 8 px under Skip (Material's 8 dp; the HIG asks about 12 for bezelled buttons), and its foot (y 116) is 2 px above a card's highest top (`STACK_TOP` 118) on a 320 to 375 px phone, so more gap means raising `STACK_TOP`; no journey pictures the long line under the clock ("Passed … without stopping", RY21) at 320 px, held or not, nor at 390 px, where it has 122 px beside "Skip to end" and had 210: the room is arithmetic (`topRow().room` in `ceremony/room.ts` since `replay-ceremony ui 10`; `replay-pace ui 2`, `ui 3`), and a 360 x 640 picture was asked for too

- The replay's words since the owner's defaults (Nov 20, decision 0242, `replay-ceremony ui 10`): Pause, Play while paused, "Paused · tap to play", and "Skip to end" from 390 px of width up; narrower, the button shows "Skip" and is spoken "Skip to the end". The widths the row needs (`TOP_ROW` in `ceremony/room.ts`) are measured in headless Chromium's font, not a phone's, and "Skip to end" at exactly 390 px has no slack beside the widest short date ("Wed, Sep 30"). The three top buttons have 12 px of side padding where they had 16, and `STAGE_SIDE` is 95 where it was 90, so the line under the clock has 130 px at 320 px where it had 140. A line of four rows under the clock at 390 px would reach a card by about 6 px; none was pictured. No cold find has read the new words

argv: 0242: the sheet is taller while the gap question is inside it (replay-ceremony ui 11)
ops.body: - [owner] The card's map leaves 116 px at the top where it left 48 (`WHOLE_TOP`: the top row and a standing picture's height), on both replays and after Skip too: the last view and the card are one view (RC24), and at 320 px the top row and the date sat on the walk's pictures. On a 320 by 568 phone the walk has about 56 px of room above the card, and while a gap question is asked inside the sheet (`replay-ceremony ui 11`) the sheet is taller still (half the screen, 70% at the most), so the last view frames the walk higher from the start

argv: The last view's date stands where the clock stood
0242: between Pause and Skip, and the short form at 390 px too (replay-ceremony ui 10)
ops.body: - [owner] The last view's date stands where the clock stood, between Pause and Skip, in one line: the full weekday only with 250 px of room ("Thu, Nov 19" at 320 px, and at 390 px too since "Skip to end" took the room there, `replay-ceremony ui 10`). The prototype shows the full date under the clock; there it lay over pictures at 320 px

argv: What can cover what on the stage
0242: names fall back to the one line (replay-ceremony ui 14)
ops.body: - What can cover what on the stage: a standing picture covers a note's pin at the same stop until the card; a tall stack can stand over the east end of the walk on the last view; the passed place's name on the last view is a large pill over the ground beside the path. One or two names that cannot each stand clear of the walk, its pictures and one another are said as the card's one line under the walk (`replay-ceremony ui 14`, `said.ts` `lastNames`): a name's box is an estimate (8.2 px a letter, no text is measured), any picture within about 150 px of a name over its place collapses two names to the one line, and a walk running north to south nearly always gets the one line. The one line standing over the walk (no room under it) and names placed with reduce motion are held by unit tests alone. With reduce motion and no bounds (a day of placeless moments) pictures are not drawn. A card is 204 px wide where it was 211 under about 341 px, to stay clear of the stack

argv: Fixed under the owner's defaults, decision 0242 (replay-ceremony ui 11): asked inside the sheet
From the UI review's fixes (`replay-ceremony ui 1` to `ui 8`, Nov 19), a whisper
0242: one at a time and beside a way up the screen (replay-ceremony ui 12, ui 13); what is left
ops.body: - A passed place's whisper, after the UI review's fixes and the owner's defaults (`replay-ceremony ui 5`, `ui 12`, `ui 13`; decision 0242): it stands under the line on a white ground, or beside the line at its left where the way runs up or down the screen by more than 2 to 1. A way between 45° and 63° keeps the place under the line, where the box can still meet a slanted line; its side is decided once from 15 s of walk either side of the pass, so on a bend it can still meet the line; at 320 px a place more than about 4 m left of the line has no room beside it (128 px at the most) and falls back; if the camera then moves the line left the box stays 8 px in and nears the line. Its floor is the map's marks at the foot of the screen where it was 120 px up, so on a short phone it can reach a note's bubble in the corner. Places whose whispers would be up together are said as one line at the last of them, so the first of two close places is named a moment after the walker has passed it, and in the 128 px beside the line at 320 px the longer line takes four rows (pictured, whole). Bends, and widths between 320 and 390 px, are untested. With reduce motion a whisper can still stand under the clock

argv: A hop's dots stand on white discs
Settled by the owner's defaults, decision 0242 (replay-ceremony ui 9): a hairline casing

ops.body: - A hop's dots have a hairline casing while the replay tells (`replay-ceremony ui 9`, decision 0242: `HOP_EDGE` 5 px under a 3 px dot, where `ui 6` drew 6 px discs). At 3x the dots read apart, each in a thin ring over a walked street; at 1x on plain land the casing still blurs into a faint lighter line, much thinner than the discs' ribbon. Contrast was read from the tokens, pixels looked at in two enlarged pictures by hand. The journey reads the edge from the path's third frame (the first is drawn before the map's effect writes it), which narrows what that check sees

- The gap question inside the card's sheet (`replay-ceremony ui 11`, decision 0242; `lib/replay.ts` `keepAskPlace`): asked there when under 96 px of the walk's room would stay clear over a floating question, so at 320 by 568 and not at 390 by 844; sizes between were not pictured. While it is inside, the sheet is capped at half the screen (70% at the most) and the card's own buttons (Watch again, Name it) are under a scroll until the question is answered. The sheet's ground and corners moved from its scroller to a view around it (`sheetFrame`): with the ground on the scroller and the content overflowing, whole-page screenshots in headless Chromium showed the map blank above the sheet while the map's own pixels were right; whether a real browser ever showed it is unknown. The day's card sheet still has its ground on its scroller (its content does not overflow today)

- Thin in the owner's defaults' tests (`replay-ceremony ui 9` to `ui 14`, Nov 20): one tests-first commit and one code commit for all six, a second commit after the journeys' pictures that changed tests with their code, and `ui 12` changed once more after the pictures (its failing test first). `check:test-first replay-ceremony` cannot see the order without `TEST_FIRST_BASE` (the entry on that base above). The `replay` journey gained a fourth seeded walk (`seedNorthWalk`), about a minute more. `ui 5`'s whisper check now pauses in the page the frame the whisper is nearly whole. Older tests rewritten to the new words and places: `ui 5`, `ui 6`, RC25, RP19, MS17, `tend replay 11`, `replay-pace ui 2` and `ui 3`

- [ ] **Do:** replay a walk with a break of 20 minutes or more that crossed some distance. **Expect:** the hop is grey dots, each in a thin white ring where it crosses a walked street and separate dots on plain land, never a white ribbon; the rings go when the card arrives (`replay-ceremony ui 9`; `WalkMap.native.tsx` draws `HOP_EDGE`, now 5 px).

- [ ] **Do:** watch a replay on a 390 pt iPhone and on a 375 pt one (an SE or a mini), with VoiceOver on for the second. **Expect:** on 390 the top row reads Pause, the clock, "Skip to end", with nothing touching and Next under it; on 375 the button reads "Skip" and VoiceOver says "Skip to the end"; on the last view the date sits between Pause and Skip without touching either (`replay-ceremony ui 10`; `room.ts` `topRow` sizes the row from widths measured in a desktop browser's font).

- [ ] **Do:** in a replay tap Pause, then tap the map. **Expect:** the button reads Play and "Paused · tap to play" sits under the clock; the tap on the map plays again and the button reads Pause (`replay-ceremony ui 10`; `Stage.tsx`, both replays).

- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone SE (or any phone about 568 pt tall) end a walk that has a gap with a likely way, and let its replay reach the card; then tap Keep it, open Name it and type. Do the same on a tall phone. **Expect:** on the short phone "Keep the likely way?" is the first thing in the card's sheet, the walk is in view above it, no floating card flashes first, and VoiceOver reads the question once; after the answer the sheet is the card's alone and rises with the keyboard as before; on the tall phone the question floats over the map as it did (`replay-ceremony ui 11`; `KeepGapsCard` inline, `sheetFrame` inside the `KeyboardAvoidingView`).

- [ ] **Do:** replay a walk that goes north or south past one place without stopping, and one that passes two places within a few seconds of replay. **Expect:** "Passed … without stopping" stands at the left of the line, level with the place, wrapping in its narrower room and never across the line or the walker; the two close places are said in one line ("Passed A and B without stopping") as the walker reaches the second, and no two lines are ever up together (`replay-ceremony ui 12`, `ui 13`; `Whispers.tsx`).

- [ ] **Do:** replay to the end a walk that passed two places and has photos along it, on a narrow phone; and one that passed a single place with nothing near it. **Expect:** the first ends with one line under the walk naming both places, clear of the walk's line and its pictures; the second names its place beside it, as before (`replay-ceremony ui 14`; `Whispers.tsx` places what `said.ts` `lastNames` decided).
